title: Agent access turned off
prompt: (Any command while the person has turned agents off)
rubric: Tells the person to turn on Settings → Agents rather than retrying.

calls: (Settings → Agents: Let agents use ToolBelt → off)
origin.notes: Turning the switch off closes the socket and removes the file. The CLI's error says what to do, and exit code 1 tells scripts that ToolBelt can't be reached.
